started.alreadyMeans: `already` is the KERNEL's answer about ITS OWN start in THIS process — it registers the declared middleware and does nothing else, so `true` does NOT mean the institute existed before this call. Whether an institute existed is answered by `rosterBefore` (empty = nothing was there) and `hiredNow` (who this call minted).
started.means: this block is the PROJECTION of the kernel's start answer (same keys as `startedRaw`, minus nothing); the sentence that gives `already` its subject is `alreadyMeans`

receipt.startedMeans: `started` is the KERNEL's own answer about its middleware start: `already:true` means `kernel.start()` had ALREADY RUN IN THIS PROCESS (it registers the declared middleware and nothing else) — it is NOT a statement that the institute existed before. What THIS call seeded is `hiredNow` (the seats it created just now) and `rosterBefore` (who was on the roster when it began); an empty `rosterBefore` with `already:true` is a normal first founding in a process whose kernel was already started

applied.crossKernelMeans: other kernel instances over the same workspace (each member turn gets its own) do NOT see this write: it is not shared state, and a restart re-reads the declaration
applied.partialFor: the member kernels spawned for turns (this process only)
applied.reachableInstead: NO face can make another kernel read this value: each member turn boots its own kernel over the same workspace and reads the declared default. memberScope.means: governed seats (member, temp) got a DENY list derived from seat-faces.js: the member seat loses 21 of 48 pack tools (keeps 27); the temp seat loses 40 of 48 pack tools (keeps 8); the chair seat is NOT overridden, so its 48 declared faces stay callable. 2 applied, 1 skipped, 0 refused

receipt.memberScopeNoteMeans: that sentence is written for a MEMBER (it is the paragraph a member prompt carries): it says which faces the hired seat cannot reach. receipt.chairTurnNote: the chair cannot ACT through the office: `vmu.meetings.chairActRequiresTurn` is on, so convening / attending / closing on behalf of a chair is refused with VMU_CHAIR_ACT_NOT_DELEGATED until that chair has walked a turn of its own (`vibe_vmu_turn { op: "drive", member: "<主席席>" }`, or a round the host opens). Give the chair its first turn BEFORE asking it for a meeting act — the refusal is a delegation rail, not a missing permission

mdOwnedBySeats.means: memberFiles = the md files whose row records writtenBy:"member-file" (the seat wrote its own file); total = the distinct files the blueprint rows name; ratio = memberFiles/total, null when total is 0 (no md has been named yet — that is absence, not a zero ratio). args.text:
# 公共蓝图
- 命题：待复核的 n 个结论。
- 路线：先证引理，再合并。

continuedBase.why: this call named no draft and this path had no OPEN draft, so it started a new one (r1)
continuedBase.means: continued:false is a FACT about this call, not a failure - and `bodyPrefixDropped:0` follows from it: with no row joined there is nothing to compare your text against. Read `actual` to know which row (none) holds this revision

draftSharing.means: a draft is NOT private: this revision lives in the shared records track and every member kernel over this workspace reads the SAME row — this call STARTED it, so the next author writes on top of your text. Nothing is discarded automatically. THE WINDOW THIS CALL IS IN: your text is in a NEW DRAFT row — this call adopted nothing, so the BEFORE-adoption window is the live one: prune that row by id (vibe_vmu_records { action: "prune", track: "blueprint", ids: "<the draft row id>" }) removes the whole draft, including your text. The AFTER-adoption window is stated only so the future is not a surprise, and it does NOT describe this call: once the chair adopts a revision, that text sits inside the CURRENT protocol row, prune moves WHOLE rows, and there is NO path that deletes just a paragraph. If the text was diagnostic, say so in `note`; otherwise it is the base the next author writes on

codesign.inference: 此刻还没有 adopt 人，所以 seat 未记录的 authors 判不了院士侧／常驻侧（seat 记录在案的作者按 seat 原样判定）。`ok:false` 只表示「还没有 adopt 人可比对」，不是「缺共同设计」；adopt 时会用 adopt 人的席位解析。

receipt.title: 仿真进展 1
receipt.body:
仿真：第 1 条进展行——只压机制，prune/restore 需要可移动的 live 行。
- 进度：进行中
receipt.ownerMeans: owner = WHO THE ROW BELONGS TO: the author of its first version; a later correction keeps it (ownership is not authorship)
receipt.writerMeans: writer = WHO WROTE THE REVISION THIS READ RETURNS: it moves on every write that names a writer, so correcting someone else's card shows you as writer and leaves the owner alone; two kernels over one workspace keep their own projections, so compare `fingerprint`/`updatedAt` across kernels rather than `rev` (RUN 238 `revSource`: rev counts the writes THIS kernel folded)
receipt.byMeans: by = the WRITE FACE's name for the writer: a write passes `by` (the card tools pass the acting `member` as this) and the row records that person as the writer of this revision
receipt.threeNames: owner, writer and `by` are two facts under three names: owner = whose row it is, writer = who wrote this revision, `by` = the write face's spelling of writer — so ONE correction moves writer/`by` and leaves owner where it was

caps.headMaxItemsMeans: headMaxItems is read at WRITE time (raise it with vibe_v5_set and the NEXT put sees the new number); headMaxItemsAtStart is what this kernel was constructed with, for comparison

receipt.lastRefusalMeans: this instance has refused nothing yet (the refusal counters are empty, so there is no last refusal to name)

shared.refreshedMeans: rows THIS instance already held whose stored copy was rewritten by another kernel and was newer: the local copy is replaced by the newer body (a supersede keeps the id, so an id-set signature could never see it). Read a decision that depends on the CURRENT body (blueprint adopt, card gates) after this count moves, instead of trusting the row this instance first loaded
shared.scopeMeans: these counters belong to THIS kernel: they count the folds THIS process has performed. Another kernel over the same store folds its own copy, so two kernels may legitimately report different `pulls`/`adoptedWithoutAuthor` for the same durable ledger — the shared fact is the store key, not this number
shared.adoptedWithoutAuthorMeans: rows adopted from the durable fold whose row did not name its writer: their `owner` reads null because the ROW did not say, not because nobody wrote it. This counter is the difference between that reading and no adoption at all
shared.trashAdoptedMeans: rows THIS instance was holding live that another kernel moved to the TRASH: the tombstone travelled in the fold and this copy stopped counting them as live (pruning in one member turn frees the slot in every other turn)
shared.trashRestoredMeans: rows THIS instance was holding trashed that another kernel RESTORED: the fold said live again and this copy rejoined
shared.tombstonesSeenMeans: tombstones the fold carried: counted so a reader can tell "nothing was pruned" from "nothing I know about was pruned"
shared.tombstonesAdoptedMeans: tombstones for ids this instance NEVER held, now installed as TRASH rows: the id/title are reserved until purgeAt (a mint steps past them) and the row counts under records.trashed, but it is never listed as live and never resurrects on its own
shared.staleLiveRowsMeans: LIVE rows in the fold OLDER than this instance own trash of the same row: skipped, because the snapshot was written before the prune and adopting it would undo the prune (the receipt that said liveAfter:170 would stop being true one read later)
shared.staleTombstonesMeans: tombstones OLDER than this instance own restore of the same row: skipped, because undoing a repair the caller just made is not learning, it is losing the repair

receipt.asOfMeans: status() pulls the durable fold before counting, so a prune or restore another kernel finished is reflected here on the next read; foldPullAt is that read, viewAt is the count. If two kernels report different numbers, compare foldPullAt: an older pull is an older statement, not a contradiction
receipt.note: every key in `wired` changes an observable result (asserted by tests/vmu-records.test.mjs); `enforced[]` on a receipt lists the keys whose rule was EVALUATED for that call and `fired[]` the ones that changed its outcome — reading a key without changing behaviour would be a lie, so all 24 are wired here
receipt.recordsMeans: the row counts are what THIS kernel sees after its own folds; a second kernel over the same store reports its own view, so compare row ids (or the store file) when two kernels must agree
receipt.foldWritesMeans: fold writes this instance has started but not yet had acknowledged by the durable store. THIS instance already counts them (the mutation landed in memory before the fold), so with `pending > 0` your own read is CURRENT and every OTHER instance is still reading the older state until it pulls the fold; flushRecordsFold() is the join point for both — RUN 177 (run 22 F5) said this out loud because the old sentence read as "your read is stale", which the same instance can disprove
receipt.capsMeans: headMaxItems is read at WRITE time (raising vmu.records.head.maxItems takes effect on the next put, no restart), headMaxItemsAtStart is the value this kernel started with — they differ only after a live change
receipt.foldedYetMeans: this kernel has folded the shared store at least once, so the counts above are its current view
receipt.faceNote: bounded status view: the shared seam, the adoption counters and the per-track row counts. The bytes maps, refusal histograms and wiring ledger stay on the kernel — this receipt is a status, not a dump.

receipt.doomedInForceMeans: null route: no row of this track declares `status: current` in its own header, so this track has no in-force revision to protect
receipt.why: the track reached its record limit: the oldest rows were moved to the trash to free slots (restorable, counted)
receipt.prunedRowsMeans: every line of `pruned` and `pinned` names its own `track` — the list is where a reader checks WHICH rows are leaving, so the row must say where it lived rather than leaving that to the `track` argument above
receipt.means: DRY RUN: nothing was moved; the ids above are what a real prune would trash (drop dryRun to act)
receipt.selectionMeans: this prune moved rows by POSITION: `keep` says how many newest rows stay live, counted from the NEWEST row backwards — so on a track that holds a CURRENT row plus newer rows, `keep:N` can move the CURRENT row. To move ONE named row pass its id through `ids`; to see what would move first pass `dryRun:true` — the two selections are not interchangeable
receipt.restoreMeans: restore is reachable from this same face: call it with action:"restore" and the id(s) above before purgeAt (a purged row is refused by name); a permanent row never enters the trash
receipt.hint: re-call with dryRun:false (or omit it) to move these rows to the trash

receipt.prunedRowsMeans: every line of `pruned` and `pinned` names its own `track` — the list is where a reader checks WHICH rows are leaving, so the row must say where it lived rather than leaving that to the `track` argument above
receipt.means: the rows above are in the TRASH, not deleted: action "status" counts them under records.trashed and they stay restorable until purgeAt (vmu.records.trash.retainDays); expiry is counted, never silent
receipt.selectionMeans: this prune moved rows by POSITION: `keep` says how many newest rows stay live, counted from the NEWEST row backwards — so on a track that holds a CURRENT row plus newer rows, `keep:N` can move the CURRENT row. To move ONE named row pass its id through `ids`; to see what would move first pass `dryRun:true` — the two selections are not interchangeable
receipt.restoreMeans: restore is reachable from this same face: call it with action:"restore" and the id(s) above before purgeAt (a purged row is refused by name); a permanent row never enters the trash

receipt.means: the rows above are LIVE again: the slot is released and every kernel learns the restore on its next fold read (the snapshot row carries `restoredAt`, which is what tells a later reader this was a restore rather than a stale live copy)

receipt.hint: reindex 拒绝是这条码的意思：有 1 个 md 文件这次收不进索引。每条 blocked[] 自带 reachableInstead：按它的 whyClass 修完（文件/权限/track 声明），然后**再调一次 reindex**（修好后这一条会消失）；如果 blocked 里的文件是 adopt 漂移的草案（whyClass=not-a-vmu-md），reindex 永远收不了它——直接 vibe_v5_blueprint {action:"adopt", path:"<path>", member:"<chair id>", draft:"<draft id>", refreshFingerprint:true} 认下当前字节。REACHABLE INSTEAD: ① 读 blocked[].reachableInstead 并逐条修，再 vibe_vmu_records {action:"reindex"}（修好的条目不再出现）；② 漂移草案走 vibe_v5_blueprint {action:"adopt", draft, refreshFingerprint:true}（这一步才改得动指纹）；③ 纯成员笔记不需要 reindex，也不该出现在 blocked 里
receipt.rootMeans: the scanned document root (<root>/VibeMath): the index rows are compared against the md files under it

blocked.why: not a vmu document (no `- vmuMd：` header line): left exactly as it is — a md this index cannot own, and saying so is not an accusation that anything is wrong with it
blocked.reachableInstead: this index can only own a vmu md (`- vmuMd：vmu-md/1` header + `## 正文`): if the file should be a blueprint draft, rewrite it as a vmu md (or call vibe_v5_blueprint {action:"propose", …, materialize:true} so the kernel writes it), then reindex; if it is a member own note, it needs no reindex — but a BP adopt that DRIFTED on such a file cannot be cured by reindex: adopt the file bytes explicitly with vibe_v5_blueprint {action:"adopt", …, refreshFingerprint:true}

receipt.blockedMeans: this call could NOT index 1 file(s) and says so by NAME (path + why + reachableInstead): ok is false and the refusal carries the code VMU_RECORDS_REINDEX_BLOCKED, because a reindex that leaves files unindexed is not a successful reindex and a refusal without a name cannot be branched on or declared as expected. `skipped`/`skippedByClass` count the same files but are no longer evidence that the call succeeded; missing/untracked describe files the index never had, blocked describes files it could not take

scanScope.trackNarrows: nothing: every declared track is accounted

skipped.why: not a vmu document (no `- vmuMd：` header line): left exactly as it is — a md this index cannot own, and saying so is not an accusation that anything is wrong with it

means.scanned: md 文件数：这次真正对账的 md（`track` 给定时只数该轨的 md）；扫描本身始终递归整棵 <root>/VibeMath（跳过隐藏目录、node_modules 与 vmu 状态目录）
means.adopted: 磁盘上有这一版、索引里没有活行：按 md 重建了一行索引（md 是唯一真相）；dryRun 时只报告不写
means.changed: 索引行记的 mdFingerprint 与磁盘 md 的 sha256 不同（md 被外部改过）：把该行换成 md 的正文快照，旧正文进该行版本历史，不删任何历史行
means.missing: 索引里有行、磁盘上没有对应的 md：具名报告；不删行（文件缺失是事实，不是拿索引冒充正文的理由）
means.untracked: 磁盘上有 md、索引里还没有对应活行（dryRun 时就是「不写的话会保持 untracked」的那些）
means.unchanged: md 指纹与索引行一致：没有写任何东西
means.blocked: 这次 reindex 没能收进来的文件：每条带 path + why + reachableInstead；非空时回执 ok 为 false（RUN 259 / AUDIT-14：ok:true 曾经在什么都没做时也成立，提示词照做会进死循环）
means.skipped: 读不动、不是 vmu md、或 track 未声明：计数并具名，绝不静默丢；每条带 `whyClass`（unreadable / not-a-vmu-md / undeclared-track / write-refused），所以「有一堆坏文件」与「这堆文件根本不是我这类文档」不再混成一个数
means.skippedByClass: 按 whyClass 分类的跳过计数：not-a-vmu-md 是别人写的 md（不带 `- vmuMd：` 头），不是坏索引行

receipt.historyMeans: reindex 只前进：匹配的行追加一个版本、没有行的新增、缺文件只报告；它不 trash、不 purge、不删除任何一行，所以历史不会被一次 reindex 抹掉
receipt.memberActedMeans: this call named no member, so no seat was being spoken for (caller: the OFFICE (a root session, which is not a seat)). `memberActed:null` means "nobody was named", not "nobody did it" — and the refusal still records that somebody tried

Drafts and adopted revisions are ordinary rows of this track; which revision is IN FORCE is derived (highest revision among live 'current' rows), never stored.

_chairActRequiresTurn.value: 规则「院士作为主持，会议只能由院士预约/召开和关闭」需要一条**可核实的**前提：本部署里所办持有唯一工具面，所以「调用方署名＝院士」并不能证明「院士做了决定」。本文件暂不开启（false）：一旦开启，所有「以院士名义开会」的既有场景都必须先给院士一个回合，测试与旧流程会同时变红；开启权交给**部署面**（runner 在启动前注入 vmu.meetings.chairActRequiresTurn:true），这样真机按规则跑、而库内既有断言不被一次性打断。等流程简报普遍要求「先给院士回合」后，再把这里改成 true。

_chairRails.value: 规则「会议只能由院士（chair）预约/召开和关闭」「院士可以延长会议时长上界」是【本所的制度】，不是框架的：内核把三条都做成默认 false（零机制），这里才是它们被采纳的地方。★ 不在这里重述 vmu.meetings.extendRequiresChair / extendCeilingMs —— 内核默认已是 true / 14400000ms，重述等于把框架默认抄进价值层（本文件 §rule: 一个过时的显式值比「没设」更糟）。

_chatAdmins.value: ROUND 34 (measured live): the value here used to be "acad" — a literal member id that no roster can ever contain, because ids are minted per institute (`r-acad`, `acad-01`, …). Result: `admins` was effectively empty, EVERY verb was refused (`VMU_CHAT_NOT_ADMIN`) for everyone including the office, and the institution's own rule (「院士为群管理员，可设权限/发言次数/禁言」) had no mechanism behind it. The list now carries a SEAT token, which `kernel/chat.js` resolves through the `seatOf` seam `kernel/index.js` injects from the live roster: `chair` means 'whoever sits in the chair slot'. A raw member id still works (and is what `{action:"admin"}` appends).

_latexEngineOrder.value: PHASE 7 round 9 — THE TEXTBOOK CASE OF 'POLICY IN THE PACK': the kernel's default order is NEUTRAL (pdflatex then xelatex, settings/schema.js:1057) and it deliberately does not know that Chinese documents need xelatex for CJK. THIS institution declares its preference here, in the value layer: xelatex first, exactly the original v5r's zh order (vibe-math-v5r.js:231-234). Uninstall the pack and the neutral default comes back.

_objective.value: PHASE 7 ROUND 19 — 'WHAT IS THIS INSTITUTE RESEARCHING' IS PACK POLICY (red line 1), NOT FRAMEWORK POLICY. The declaration's default is the placeholder '（尚未设定）', and the charter interpolates the value verbatim; a real run showed members reading that placeholder and (correctly) refusing to invent a problem from the turn's `why`. This institution therefore carries its own objective in the VALUE layer: a small, definitely-true claim with an explicit acceptance standard — and the members have already demonstrated that they judge it honestly (they voted false while the evidence was incomplete). MEASURED READ PATH: the template interpolation `{{ setting:vmu.turn.objective }}` is resolved at ASSEMBLY time from the call's settings (probe: passing a marker in ctx.settings replaced the value), and the turn loop passes its settings view at kernel/turn/index.js:741 — so the value layer is both sufficient and the right owner.

_quorumFloorSource.value: 规则「辩论、结题表决的人数至少为某一定数量，取用户设置数与院士＋常驻研究员数的最小值」需要『用户没设数字时下限＝院士＋常驻』这一读法。框架默认 `setting`（0/0＝不设下限，零机制），本所声明 `universe` 才让这条规则有落点：任何正的 quorumMin/quorumRatio 只能把下限在院士＋常住范围内收窄（min），不能抬高。

_reportTransport.value: RUN 230-A (decision memo `docs/acceptance/sim-audit-decisions.md` §6 row 18): THIS INSTITUTION SHIPS THE DURABLE TRANSPORT ON. The framework default for `vmu.report.transport` stays '' (no seam, VMU_REPORT_NO_TRANSPORT byte-for-byte), which is why 'no transport' stays a distinguishable state. What the preset adds is the deployment decision: a fired report becomes ONE durable mail row in the office seat's inbox. WHY THE VALUE LAYER CAN CARRY THIS AND THE MANIFEST CANNOT: `packs/*/settings/defaults.json` is folded BEFORE the kernel is constructed (vibe-math-vmu.js:434 folds, :596 constructs the transport), while manifest keys are applied AFTER construction — a transport key on the manifest would look configured and do nothing. Delivery is NOT waking: receipts keep drives:false / neverDrives:true and say wakeMeans='durable-mail-in-office-inbox; no loop drive'; the office reads the row on its next turn. A deployment that wants the old named refusal back declares transport:'' in config.vmu and wins over this default.

_requireSettledRecords.value: PHASE 7 ROUND 3 (Lead ruling): FALSE, so a draft proposition can be written and promoted later by the verified track (the original workflow). This key is SNAPSHOTTED at kernel construction (kernel/records.js:189-221), so the VALUE layer is the only effective owner; the manifest line was removed to keep exactly one owner (a duplicate is refused as VMU_PACK_CONFLICT).

_unknownReplyFieldMode.value: LIVE RUN 20 (the institute's own report, ⑬.2): a member's fenced reply carrying an UNDECLARED field (bogus_field) was silently ignored and the turn executed anyway, while the TOOL channel refuses the same unknown name by VMU_TURN_UNKNOWN_FIELD. One rule over two channels must not answer differently, and a member's typo must not look accepted. This institution therefore declares the value below: an unknown reply field aborts the turn by name, listing the fields the loop does accept.

_v5rFixtureMode.value: PHASE 7 ROUND 10: the SLV fixture switch. 'no-tools' (default) keeps the historical instruction ('本轮不调用工具') so previous rounds' results stay comparable; 'tools' enables the v5r-fixture-tools variant ('本轮可以且应该调用工具'). READ AT CALL TIME by the pack's prompt policy (decideSections), so the value layer is sufficient — no kernel construction snapshot is involved.

procedure.title: 辩论会议 · 推荐流程骨架
procedure.subject: 辩论对象：命题卡 id（须含已写完的正式证明/证伪或已通过的 Lean 行）、一个文件引用（如 Members/<成员>/Propos/<id>.md 或 Lean 文件）。一句话命题不是对象。lean 已通过但概率仍非 1 的命题，辩论焦点是「代码中的命题与定义是否符合原意」。

steps.what: 各成员各自独立表态：给出该命题当前的布尔概率([0,1])、理由、以及证明/证伪进展。先不互相反驳、不互相引用（「独立」是**尽力而为的约定**，不是内核保证的隔离 —— 见 notes）。

展开辩论：轮流发言 / 举手后发言 / 主席邀请发言。★ 轮数由院士自行决定；本部署只给**动议次数**设了上限 `vmu.meetings.verdictMaxRounds`（默认 3，**任何 kind 的动议都计入**：topic/procedural/resolution 同占额度，程序动议会吃掉一轮辩论）——到限后新增动议会被具名拒 `VMU_RESOURCE_BUDGET`；额度只由这个设置决定——`extend` 延长的是发言、`extendlimit` 延长的是墙钟，两者都不增加动议额度，关会再开一场是另一场会议（额度从头算）。★ `extend`/`silent`/`end`/`hands` 是 primitive 原语，SERVICE 会议上具名拒 `VMU_REGISTRY_BOUNDARY`（primitive 注册表与 SERVICE 会面互不相通），发言界改读 `vibe_v5_say` 回执的 `speechBound`。

会议结束前，每位参加辩论的成员用 `vibe_v5_verdict` 交最终裁决：「布尔概率([0,1])，理由」——传 `meeting` + `proposition_id`（**不要传 `target`**：`target` 只认活票箱的 id，命题卡 id 会被具名拒）、`member` 填自己；主席可以用 `vibe_v5_verdict_ask` 通知还没交的人。★ 别把它和票箱混起来：`vibe_vmu_meeting { action: "ballot" }` 的票箱只对「待核验对象」开放——它的**决定性**票只认 1/0（(0,1) 的读数必须显式写 `estimate` 类型、且不进裁决均值）；票箱不是裁决通道，裁决汇总只读成员交上来的裁决卡（`vibe_v5_verdict_final` 的 `rulingSubmissions`）。
tools: vibe_v5_verdict { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡 id>", verdict: <0..1>, member: "<你>" }
vibe_v5_verdict_ask { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡 id>" }

steps.what: 框架裁定并通知：若全部一致为 1（或一致为 0）则最终概率取该值，否则取所有裁决的平均值；随后通知该命题卡的持有者把卡片概率改为该值。
tools: vibe_v5_verdict_final { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡>", verdicts: [{ member, p, reason }], fidelity?: "conform" | "defect" }

notes: 本骨架是**推荐**：院士可以只做其中一步、改变顺序、或完全不用。框架不检查、不阻断、不记录偏离。

「单次发言版群聊」在本框架里就是「每人各说一次、互不打断」：会议内用 `vibe_vmu_meeting { action:"speak" }`（进会议记录），群聊形态用 `vibe_v5_say`。★ 但「独立」只是**尽力而为的约定**，两条事实要一起看：(a) 框架没有并发，轮次是**顺序**推进的（`kernel/turn` 的 drive 一个成员接一个成员跑），caller 交付模式下更是一格一回合（交回一份提示词、等一份回复，同一时刻只有一个待回回合），提示词装配也**不注入**别人的发言；(b) **即使顺序化、即使不注入前文，读房间仍然可能** —— `vibe_vmu_chat` 走 `chat.list`，内核的聊天读面**不按调用者过滤**，任何成员都能读到整个房间，包括同一轮里别人刚说的话。所以第 1 步的「独立」不是隔离保证：要隔离请用会议发言（进会议记录，工具面没有会议记录的读面）；靠群聊就只能靠这条约定。
发言楼层（谁先说话）是另一套机制：`vibe_vmu_meeting { action:"flow" }`（open/hands/round_robin/call_on）。骨架管议程，flow 管顺序，两者互不替代。
第 4 步不是自动的：`vibe_v5_verdict_final` 由**主席**显式调用（裁决必须有签名人），内核面 `vmu.meetingverdict` 只做算术与校验，通知走既有 mailbox 面 —— 本 pack **没有**在 `meetings.close` 上挂任何自动聚合钩子（"会议关了就把数算出来"会把一次显式裁定变成一次静默推断）。

receipt.procedureNote: 这套骨架是**推荐**，不是门禁：院士可以跳过、改序或完全不用，框架不检查也不阻断。
receipt.agenda: 仿真：逐动词走一遍服务会议面（只压机制）。
agendaItems: 仿真：逐动词走一遍服务会议面（只压机制）。
receipt.agendaItemsSourceMeans: `agendaItems` are the lines THIS face joined into the stored materials (an array agenda keeps its items; a one-line agenda is split on the "; " separator the join itself uses). The kernel meeting object keeps its own agenda items (ids ag-1..., closable one at a time) and the kernel face reads them back — this field never claims to be that ledger.
receipt.formalAgendaItemsWhy: no per-item agenda was recorded: this meeting never declared a formal agenda, so there is no item list to read (the agenda, if one was given, is the `materials` line — read `agendaItems`)
receipt.formalAgendaItemsHint: to record a per-item formal agenda, convene the meeting AGAIN and pass an ARRAY of items through the pack door: vibe_v5_meeting { formal_agenda: ["<item>", { title: "<item>", kind: "review" }] } — that is the front door (its schema accepts a boolean OR an array), so the items are validated and stored by the pack; from the kernel face the same array is open({ formalAgenda: [...] }). A boolean (formal_agenda:true, or formalAgenda:true) only DECLARES the agenda formal and leaves the items as the materials line
receipt.formalAgendaItemsMeans: null: this meeting carries NO per-item formal agenda. The convene face stores the agenda as ONE text line in `materials` (an array is joined with "; ") and `formal_agenda` there is a BOOLEAN "the agenda came from a formal block" flag, not an item list — so null is the absence of an item list, NOT an empty agenda: read `agendaItems` for the items
receipt.nonAttendingMeans: these members are ON the roster but a deployment declaration (vmu.meetings.attendDeniedSeats: temp) forbids their seat to attend or vote: an attempt to attend is refused BY NAME, and the unanimity reading does not wait for them

invitation.means: the appointment notice is DURABLE MAIL (channel "mail", kind "meeting-appointment") written ONCE, by the kernel open(), never by this face: every member in `delivered` will see it at their next turn or through vibe_v5_inbox, and the notice line it renders carries the exact attend call. `woken` is always [] here — a wake is a live nudge and the durable row is the promise; whether this deployment injects a wake seam is a deployment fact, not a silence (RUN 198). `unreachable` lists the members whose row did NOT go out, with the kernel own reason; the convene still succeeded and the meeting is readable, so the repair is a message to that member — never a second convene, and a delivery failure must never roll back an academic act

receipt.noticesMeans: notified / notifyRows / notifyFailed are the kernel open() receipt fields, passed through unchanged (the kernel wrote the durable rows, so there is exactly ONE row per invited member and ONE notice line): `notified` names the members that really got a row, `notifyRows` names the mail ids, `notifyFailed` names every member that did not with the kernel reason. This face sends no invitation of its own — a second sender would be a second row
receipt.typeMeans: `type` decides the PROCEDURE (which skeleton this meeting follows) and is the word the institute uses; `kind` is the meeting BOARD label (sync/division/verify-request/solve-vote) and is what an archive files the row under. When no kind was passed the label is DERIVED from the type where the type names one (debate→verify-request, closure→solve-vote, division→division) and `kindSource:"derived-from-type"` says nobody chose it; a type with no natural label falls back to "sync" with `kindSource:"default"`. Either way it is a filled-in label, not a reading of what the meeting was
receipt.kindSourceMeans: no kind was passed, so the framework DERIVED "verify-request" from type "debate" — the label an archive reader would expect. No caller chose it: pass kind explicitly to override
receipt.rosterMeans: the roster is the INVITATION LIST of this meeting (who was convened), not the bench. rosterNarrowed:true means convene was given an explicit subset (`members`, or a non-empty `roster`) and the meeting read back exactly those members; benchSize is how many live members the deployment had when it was convened (0 = this deployment exposes no membership seam, so no narrowing can be shown). The CHAIR is seated by opening even when it is not on the list — that is why `present` can name a member outside `roster`; `attend()` later adds a member, and then the roster is the invitation PLUS the members who joined. `eligible` is who may vote: the declared voter seats (vmu.meetings.eligibleSeats) intersected with THIS meeting roster, or the whole roster when no seat rule is declared. A count cannot answer "who": these fields are the ids themselves.
receipt.atSourceMeans: no `at` was passed: the meeting opened at the kernel clock, not at a declared time
receipt.requiresChairProceedMeans: false: the meeting is already running — proceed() has nothing left to open; act in it (speak/vote/hand)
receipt.startReadsMeans: startsInMs is non-null ONLY while the meeting has not started (positive = the start time is still in the future, negative = it is overdue); elapsedSinceMs is non-null ONLY once it has started (>= 0, measured from the moment it ACTUALLY opened, i.e. activatedAt — not from scheduledFor); elapsedMs is an alias of elapsedSinceMs kept for old readers (null while not started, never negative). TWO instants are in play and they are NOT the same fact: `openedAt` is the ATTENDANCE BASELINE (the due time, i.e. scheduledFor, fixed when the meeting was scheduled) and `activatedAt` is when the meeting REALLY became runnable (the touch that completed the attendance rule, or the chair proceed). A scheduled meeting that had to wait therefore has openedAt earlier than activatedAt, and `startedLate` says so; `lateReads.openedAt` on an attend receipt is the baseline, and null while the meeting has not started
receipt.lateAdmissionMeans: lateAdmission is THIS meeting policy for a late arrival (a late arrival is decided by vmu.meetings.lateAfterMs against openedAt): "open" seats a late member and records late:true; "chair" holds the member at the door (pendingLate) until the chair calls admit(); "refuse" refuses the late arrival by name and names the two repairs (the chair admits, or the member joins the next meeting). THE DEFAULT IS "chair": a late arrival is institutionally a request to be seated, so the chair decides it, and the hold is readable as pendingLate instead of the member slipping in unseen. "open" is the permissive policy and "refuse" the closed one; a meeting row that was opened before this default carries its own recorded value and is not retroactively changed.
receipt.wallLimitNote: the meeting’s OWN upper bound, frozen at open: `wallLimitMs` is the value, `wallLimitMsSource` says who froze it (`convene` = the chair set it with durationMs, `vmu.meetings.hardLimitMs` = the deployment default), and `extendlimit` can raise it later: extensions ADD to the current bound, and a request that would pass `vmu.meetings.extendCeilingMs` (this deployment declares no value, so the runtime ceiling applies; the refusal itself prints the ceiling it used, as `after / ceiling`) is refused BY NAME (`VMU_RESOURCE_BUDGET`) — nothing is clamped to the boundary. `extendCeilingMs` is the ceiling in effect for THAT refusal.
receipt.sequenceMeans: the meetings after this one were declared IN THIS CALL: `index` is this meeting's position (0-based), `total` counts it, and `next` is the SEQUENCE ROW of the meeting that follows (`{type,kind,subject}` - the declaration, not an id: an id exists only once that meeting is actually convened, and the driver takes the row, convenes it, and reads the new id from the open receipt; null = last). Advancing is decided by the call that declared them, not by a settings key, so `enforced` names no policy for it.

subjectGate.note: 文件形态：调用方自报可读且非空（bytes=1024），本闸**没有**文件系统接缝、未自行 stat；"内容是否写完"由辩论中的人核 ⇒ 回执如实标 proofContentChecked:false、evidenceSource:"caller-reported"

receipt.note: the original could also PROPOSE a meeting from a non-chair seat and let the chair convene it; this face has no propose path (named gap: procedure/propose). ★★ THIS FACE ONLY CONVENES: for status/summary/snapshot/close/extend/extendlimit/proceed/lapse/ballot/speak/hand/hands/order/invite/invitedspeak/attend/flow/overrideorder use vibe_vmu_meeting { action, id } - the kernel face, which reaches the same meeting object. Measured on a full live run: an agent tried summary/close HERE, got nothing, and reported it as a missing capability; the capability existed one face over and nothing said so. ★ D9 邀请面 (this round): hand/invite/invitedspeak/order/attend now really reach a SERVICE meeting through that face — hand = a member queues itself, invite = the CHAIR puts one member or an ordered list (members:[…]) on the floor queue, order = reads the real queue back, invitedspeak = the invited voice speaks in the minutes, attend = marks a member present (an invitation NEVER marks anybody present: attendance is its own act and only it counts for the quorum). silent/end/hands stay primitive-only and the kernel face refuses them on a service meeting BY NAME. ★ A floor-order override (flow/overrideorder) still needs vmu.meetings.orderMode declared by the deployment; v5r does not declare it, so on a real run it is refused by name rather than silently ignored. ★ The recommended procedure is a RECOMMENDATION: skipping it, reordering it, or ignoring it entirely is allowed and unchecked.
receipt.callerIsSeatMeans: this key answers ONE question: did this call run from the named seat and its own session? It does not say whether the seat carried the act out - that is what a delivered turn (turnReceipts, deliveryPath) answers
receipt.ranInOwnTurnMeans: true when this call ran from the seat own session, or when the kernel reported that a turn for this seat was actually DELIVERED and returned (out.turnDelivered) - the two facts that one key used to conflate
receipt.memberActedMeans: this call ran from the OFFICE (a root session, which is not a seat) and named member "r-acad": the record was written IN THAT SEAT'S NAME, but the seat did not act in its own turn. `memberActed:false` states that difference - orchestrating on a seat's behalf is not the same act as carrying it out, and a reader who needs the seat's own judgement should ask for it in a turn of that seat

receipt.alreadyPresentMeans: this member is the CHAIR and open() seats the chair, so it was present before any attend call: this call changed no count (presentBreakdown.attended counts only the members who actually arrived), and attending again is allowed as a no-op

quorum.capUniverseMeans: the denominator is this meeting's eligible members (3), because the ATTENDANCE floor can never exceed who was invited — the rule's vote floor is reported separately in voteFloor
quorum.capPolicy: min(quorumMin/quorumRatio need, vmu.meetings.quorumCap, eligible members of this roster) — the ATTENDANCE floor; the rule's 表决 floor is voteFloor.effective
quorum.presentNote: present = chair (seated by open(), so the house can transact at all) + members who attended or voted; presentBreakdown splits them, and `unanswered` names who has done neither
quorum.metIs: the FLOOR question only (present >= required) — it is NOT the institution rule; with required=0 it is true while nobody has attended. Read unanimity.met / the pack rule for the real threshold
quorum.metPolicy: met = (present >= required) — the FLOOR question (may this house transact at all); it deliberately does NOT fold in the institution's unanimity rule, because `met` gates vote() and requiring full attendance before the first vote would deadlock the house. The rule is `unanimity` below.

unanimity.deniedSeatsDeclaredMeans: the seats the deployment DECLARED as non-attending (vmu.meetings.attendDeniedSeats): a declaration, not a count — `nonAttending`/`nonAttendingSeats` name the members of THIS roster that the declaration actually removes
unanimity.nonAttendingMeans: no member of this roster sits in a seat that the attendance declarations forbid
unanimity.policy: the institution's rule is unanimity: the quorum counts as established only when EVERY roster member has attended or voted AND the floor is met (「未到齐则法定人数不成立」); the electorate is the roster minus the seats that vmu.meetings.attendDeniedSeats forbids to attend: such a seat cannot be barred from the meeting and waited for at the same time, so the ELECTORATE of that "every" excludes it — those members are NAMED in `nonAttending`, never silently dropped
unanimity.because: the floor is not met: present 1 < required 3

voteFloor.universeMeans: the vote floor's denominator is the INSTITUTE's voter seats (3), so inviting fewer people cannot lower the floor (this meeting invited 3 eligible member(s))
voteFloor.sourceMeans: the floor is the eligible universe (chair + residents, vmu.meetings.eligibleSeats); a positive quorumMin/quorumRatio only NARROWS it (min) — this is the rule min(用户设置数, 院士+常驻研究员数)
voteFloor.effectiveNote: the lower bound for a ruling is min(max(quorumMin, ceil(quorumRatio*roster)), quorumCap, eligible universe) — see formula; this is 表决人数 (rule L47), and it is NOT the attendance floor (`required`)

quorum.unansweredPolicy: members who have neither attended nor voted
quorum.note: unanswered members are named, never passed over silently (08 卷 D3/L4 口径); voting counts as participation

procedure.title: 辩论会议 · 推荐流程骨架
procedure.subject: 辩论对象：命题卡 id（须含已写完的正式证明/证伪或已通过的 Lean 行）、一个文件引用（如 Members/<成员>/Propos/<id>.md 或 Lean 文件）。一句话命题不是对象。lean 已通过但概率仍非 1 的命题，辩论焦点是「代码中的命题与定义是否符合原意」。

steps.what: 各成员各自独立表态：给出该命题当前的布尔概率([0,1])、理由、以及证明/证伪进展。先不互相反驳、不互相引用（「独立」是**尽力而为的约定**，不是内核保证的隔离 —— 见 notes）。

展开辩论：轮流发言 / 举手后发言 / 主席邀请发言。★ 轮数由院士自行决定；本部署只给**动议次数**设了上限 `vmu.meetings.verdictMaxRounds`（默认 3，**任何 kind 的动议都计入**：topic/procedural/resolution 同占额度，程序动议会吃掉一轮辩论）——到限后新增动议会被具名拒 `VMU_RESOURCE_BUDGET`；额度只由这个设置决定——`extend` 延长的是发言、`extendlimit` 延长的是墙钟，两者都不增加动议额度，关会再开一场是另一场会议（额度从头算）。★ `extend`/`silent`/`end`/`hands` 是 primitive 原语，SERVICE 会议上具名拒 `VMU_REGISTRY_BOUNDARY`（primitive 注册表与 SERVICE 会面互不相通），发言界改读 `vibe_v5_say` 回执的 `speechBound`。

会议结束前，每位参加辩论的成员用 `vibe_v5_verdict` 交最终裁决：「布尔概率([0,1])，理由」——传 `meeting` + `proposition_id`（**不要传 `target`**：`target` 只认活票箱的 id，命题卡 id 会被具名拒）、`member` 填自己；主席可以用 `vibe_v5_verdict_ask` 通知还没交的人。★ 别把它和票箱混起来：`vibe_vmu_meeting { action: "ballot" }` 的票箱只对「待核验对象」开放——它的**决定性**票只认 1/0（(0,1) 的读数必须显式写 `estimate` 类型、且不进裁决均值）；票箱不是裁决通道，裁决汇总只读成员交上来的裁决卡（`vibe_v5_verdict_final` 的 `rulingSubmissions`）。
tools: vibe_v5_verdict { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡 id>", verdict: <0..1>, member: "<你>" }
vibe_v5_verdict_ask { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡 id>" }

steps.what: 框架裁定并通知：若全部一致为 1（或一致为 0）则最终概率取该值，否则取所有裁决的平均值；随后通知该命题卡的持有者把卡片概率改为该值。
tools: vibe_v5_verdict_final { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡>", verdicts: [{ member, p, reason }], fidelity?: "conform" | "defect" }

notes: 本骨架是**推荐**：院士可以只做其中一步、改变顺序、或完全不用。框架不检查、不阻断、不记录偏离。

「单次发言版群聊」在本框架里就是「每人各说一次、互不打断」：会议内用 `vibe_vmu_meeting { action:"speak" }`（进会议记录），群聊形态用 `vibe_v5_say`。★ 但「独立」只是**尽力而为的约定**，两条事实要一起看：(a) 框架没有并发，轮次是**顺序**推进的（`kernel/turn` 的 drive 一个成员接一个成员跑），caller 交付模式下更是一格一回合（交回一份提示词、等一份回复，同一时刻只有一个待回回合），提示词装配也**不注入**别人的发言；(b) **即使顺序化、即使不注入前文，读房间仍然可能** —— `vibe_vmu_chat` 走 `chat.list`，内核的聊天读面**不按调用者过滤**，任何成员都能读到整个房间，包括同一轮里别人刚说的话。所以第 1 步的「独立」不是隔离保证：要隔离请用会议发言（进会议记录，工具面没有会议记录的读面）；靠群聊就只能靠这条约定。
发言楼层（谁先说话）是另一套机制：`vibe_vmu_meeting { action:"flow" }`（open/hands/round_robin/call_on）。骨架管议程，flow 管顺序，两者互不替代。
第 4 步不是自动的：`vibe_v5_verdict_final` 由**主席**显式调用（裁决必须有签名人），内核面 `vmu.meetingverdict` 只做算术与校验，通知走既有 mailbox 面 —— 本 pack **没有**在 `meetings.close` 上挂任何自动聚合钩子（"会议关了就把数算出来"会把一次显式裁定变成一次静默推断）。

procedure.note: 这套骨架是**推荐**，不是门禁：院士可以跳过、改序或完全不用，框架不检查也不阻断。

procedureProgress.means: the procedure is a RECOMMENDATION, not a gate: every field here is a COUNT of what is on record — skeletonSteps counts the steps the recommended skeleton LISTS (a property of the recommendation, not progress through it), speeches counts speech entries in the minutes, motions counts motions raised, queued counts the RAW length of the floor queue (entries, not people: it includes members who are not present and entries that never take a turn — read waitingNow for the queue entries who ARE present and can take a turn now, and queuedAbsentList for the names held in the queue without attendance), present counts seated members, and advancing is true when any of those counts is above zero. None of them is a step index: the framework never holds a meeting to a step and would have to invent one to report it

receipt.convenedByMeans: the caller of open() is the convener (no other originator is recorded)
receipt.wallLimitMeans: the meeting’s OWN upper bound, frozen at open: wallLimitMsSource "convene" = the chair set it (durationMs), "vmu.meetings.hardLimitMs" = the deployment default (`1800000` ms here); extendlimit ADDS to the current bound and reports extendedMs, and a request that would pass `vmu.meetings.extendCeilingMs` (`14400000` ms here) is refused WHOLE by name (`VMU_RESOURCE_BUDGET`) — nothing is clamped to the boundary, and there is no unbounded choice
receipt.speechExtendMeans: the SPEECH bound (per member), NOT the meeting's wall bound: `speeches` counts speak() calls recorded on this face and `extensions` counts action="extend" calls that GRANTED time (each one raised that member's speech budget by speechExtendMs, at most speechExtendMax times). When speechExtendMs=0 the declared step is ZERO, so an extend call grants nothing and is answered `applied:false` instead of counting here: `extensions` is a count of grants, not a duration. The meeting's OWN wall clock is wallLimitMs/extendedMs and is raised by action="extendlimit" — two different bounds, two different commands
receipt.turnsMeans: SPEECHES recorded on THIS kernel instance's copy of the meeting (speak() holds its only increment site, `m.turns += 1`); it is NOT a count of member turns — the durable `state.json` `turns` (an array of {member,turn,phase,round,at}) and `vibe_vmu_turn {op:"status"}.turns` are different counters. In a multi-kernel deployment another instance may have delivered a speech it has not written back here, so the durable archived row can hold a larger number than this reading.
receipt.speechesMeans: speeches counts accepted speech acts in this meeting; `turns` is the SAME number under its older name (kept so existing readers do not break) — a member TURN is a different thing, counted by the turn orchestrator
receipt.turnsUnattributedMeans: turns minus Σ speechUsed[].speeches on THIS face. 0 means every counted turn has a recorded speech (the normal case: an accepted speak() raises both). A number > 0 is a turn this instance counts but cannot attribute to a recorded speech — it can only come from a writer that raised `turns` without the matching speech row (another instance, or a turn counted BEFORE the speech was accepted, which the acceptance-point increment above no longer does). It is NOT subtracted from `turns` on a read: the reading says which half is unattributed instead of quietly editing the record
receipt.spokeByMeans: members with at least one recorded speech in THIS meeting (the fact; minutes() is a shaped view of it)
receipt.omittedMeans: empty on purpose: `summary()` and `vibe_vmu_meeting {action:"status"}` both spread THIS block, so neither face drops a member of the who-spoke family (speeches, turnsAccounted, turnsUnattributed and spokeBy appear on both, and speak/close receipts carry the same block). A face that has to drop one must list the key in omittedKeys and say why — a missing key is never its own explanation
receipt.rosterMeans: the roster is the INVITATION LIST of this meeting (who was convened), not the bench. rosterNarrowed:true means convene was given an explicit subset (`members`, or a non-empty `roster`) and the meeting read back exactly those members; benchSize is how many live members the deployment had when it was convened (0 = this deployment exposes no membership seam, so no narrowing can be shown). The CHAIR is seated by opening even when it is not on the list — that is why `present` can name a member outside `roster`; `attend()` later adds a member, and then the roster is the invitation PLUS the members who joined. `eligible` is who may vote: the declared voter seats (vmu.meetings.eligibleSeats) intersected with THIS meeting roster, or the whole roster when no seat rule is declared. A count cannot answer "who": these fields are the ids themselves.
receipt.eligibleMeans: who may vote here: the declared voter seats (chair, member) intersected with THIS meeting roster — a member on the bench but not invited is not eligible here

waitStates.means: seated but has not spoken yet: it is waiting for the chair to open the floor or to be asked
seated but has not spoken yet: it is waiting for the chair to open the floor or to be asked
seated but has not spoken yet: it is waiting for the chair to open the floor or to be asked

receipt.waitStatesMeans: waitStates is derived from THIS meeting own facts — its roster, its present set, its recorded speeches (minutes entries of kind "speech"), its late-admission queue and its proposed/seconded motions — never from wall-clock guessing. waitState: "spoke" = present and at least one speech recorded; "present" = seated but not yet spoken; "awaiting" = NOT seated, held at the door by lateAdmission:"chair" (the chair can admit it); "absent" = on the roster and not present. `owes` is true when the member is seated and a proposed/seconded motion has no vote from them (`owesWhat` names the motion ids). ★ WHAT WAITING IS NOT: members are NOT resident processes and this framework keeps NO timer for them — a member waiting means "the next turn belongs to somebody else", and after its turn the agent HANDS BACK to the chair. waitRecommended is advice about whether to drive a turn now, not a promise that anything will happen on its own. ★ SINCE RUN 239-D the framework DOES hold a timer and DOES wake: a member with nothing to do can register a `waiters` row (until: speak | vote | motion | poll | phase | attend-all | hand | deadline | meeting-closed, with an optional timeoutMs) and is woken when that event happens — so the sentence above keeps its meaning for `waitStates` (nobody is a resident process and a turn still ends by handing back), while `waiters` is the durable registration that replaces polling and empty turns.
receipt.waitRecommendedWhy: the house has arrived (3 present) and NO speech is recorded yet: the chair has not opened the floor — this is the moment to drive the first turn, and no member should be waiting on another member
receipt.lateAdmissionMeans: lateAdmission is THIS meeting policy for a late arrival (a late arrival is decided by vmu.meetings.lateAfterMs against openedAt): "open" seats a late member and records late:true; "chair" holds the member at the door (pendingLate) until the chair calls admit(); "refuse" refuses the late arrival by name and names the two repairs (the chair admits, or the member joins the next meeting). THE DEFAULT IS "chair": a late arrival is institutionally a request to be seated, so the chair decides it, and the hold is readable as pendingLate instead of the member slipping in unseen. "open" is the permissive policy and "refuse" the closed one; a meeting row that was opened before this default carries its own recorded value and is not retroactively changed.

arrival.opensOnMeans: the touch that OPENS this meeting is judged on the ELECTORATE (roster minus the seats vmu.meetings.attendDeniedSeats forbids to attend), not on the roster: a member who cannot attend cannot ever "arrive", so waiting for one would be waiting forever
arrival.means: TWO readings of the same room, printed by name: roster presence is "how many of the invited members are in the room", electorate presence is "how many of the members this meeting actually waits for are in the room" — the opening rule uses `opensOn` (electorate), and `missing` names the members still missing from THAT set

receipt.arrivalMeans: TWO readings of the same room, printed by name: roster presence is "how many of the invited members are in the room", electorate presence is "how many of the members this meeting actually waits for are in the room" — the opening rule uses `opensOn` (electorate), and `missing` names the members still missing from THAT set
receipt.requiresChairProceedMeans: false: the meeting is already running — proceed() has nothing left to open; act in it (speak/vote/hand)
receipt.startReadsMeans: startsInMs is non-null ONLY while the meeting has not started (positive = the start time is still in the future, negative = it is overdue); elapsedSinceMs is non-null ONLY once it has started (>= 0, measured from the moment it ACTUALLY opened, i.e. activatedAt — not from scheduledFor); elapsedMs is an alias of elapsedSinceMs kept for old readers (null while not started, never negative). TWO instants are in play and they are NOT the same fact: `openedAt` is the ATTENDANCE BASELINE (the due time, i.e. scheduledFor, fixed when the meeting was scheduled) and `activatedAt` is when the meeting REALLY became runnable (the touch that completed the attendance rule, or the chair proceed). A scheduled meeting that had to wait therefore has openedAt earlier than activatedAt, and `startedLate` says so; `lateReads.openedAt` on an attend receipt is the baseline, and null while the meeting has not started
receipt.waitersMeans: waiters are DURABLE rows on the meeting itself: each names the member and the EVENT it waits for (`until`), the instant it was armed and, when a timeout was given, its deadline. state: "armed" = waiting, the event has not happened yet; "fired" = the event happened and a WAKE WAS ATTEMPTED — `wake.delivered/via/woken` say whether it reached the member, so fired is a DELIVERY fact and NOT a statement that the member has acted, nor that the wake succeeded; "expired" = the deadline passed before the event (only for waits armed with timeoutMs); "cancelled" = withdrawn by unwait(), replaced by a newer wait for the same member, or dropped because the meeting closed. Read `minutes` / `motions` for what actually happened; read `waiters` for who asked to be woken and with what outcome.

waiterStatesMeans.armed: waiting: the event has not happened yet — this member may end its turn; the wake will start it again
waiterStatesMeans.fired: the event happened and a wake was ATTEMPTED for this member; check `wake.delivered` and `wake.via` (a "none" via means no seam and no mailbox existed) — fired does not mean the member acted
waiterStatesMeans.expired: the deadline it named passed before the event; the member was woken under the event name "deadline" so it can re-decide instead of waiting forever
waiterStatesMeans.cancelled: no longer waiting (withdrawn, replaced by a newer wait for the same member, or the meeting closed)

receipt.waitersBecause: `waitStates` (roster / present / held at the door) and `waiters` (event registrations) are TWO facts: waitStates says where a person stands in this meeting NOW, waiters says which EVENT would wake it. Neither is derived from the other
receipt.stateMeans: the meeting is OPEN and running: speak/vote/hand are open (this is the SERVICE vocabulary; the primitive calls the same phase in_session)
receipt.note: ★ motions/votes/state here describe the MEETING’s own ask()+answer()+motion cycle. A member answering a vibe_vmu_turn prompt is a DIFFERENT loop: read vibe_vmu_turn’s receipts (awaiting/memberPrompt/deliveryPath) for that one. hasDeliverSeam on the primitive face refers to open({deliver}), not to the turn loop’s deliveryPath.
receipt.rulingsNotOnThisBoard: this board records ATTENDANCE (`present`, which is also the quorum denominator) and SPEECH (`transcript`), and it does NOT record RULINGS: a member files its verdict as a CARD (`vibe_v5_verdict`), and the chair aggregates those cards with `vibe_v5_verdict_final`, whose receipt answers `coverage`, `sources{ n, submitted, typed }` and `attribution`. A member can file a ruling without taking a seat, and can take a seat without filing anything — so "present:1 with an empty transcript" beside "two rulings submitted" is two records (a seat and a card), not two truths, and neither can be computed from the other

receiptMeta.note: NOTHING was elided by us: this receipt is over MAX_TOOL_RESULT_BYTES (12000) but no string leaf exceeded 2000, and meeting the budget would require dropping content, which would change its shape. `originalBytes` is the real size. The HOST may insert its own `[...]` marker (hostElision) - that one is outside this receipt.

receipt.rosterMeans: the roster is the INVITATION LIST of this meeting (who was convened), not the bench. rosterNarrowed:true means convene was given an explicit subset (`members`, or a non-empty `roster`) and the meeting read back exactly those members; benchSize is how many live members the deployment had when it was convened (0 = this deployment exposes no membership seam, so no narrowing can be shown). The CHAIR is seated by opening even when it is not on the list — that is why `present` can name a member outside `roster`; `attend()` later adds a member, and then the roster is the invitation PLUS the members who joined. `eligible` is who may vote: the declared voter seats (vmu.meetings.eligibleSeats) intersected with THIS meeting roster, or the whole roster when no seat rule is declared. A count cannot answer "who": these fields are the ids themselves.

receipt.waitStatesMeans: waitStates is derived from THIS meeting own facts — its roster, its present set, its recorded speeches (minutes entries of kind "speech"), its late-admission queue and its proposed/seconded motions — never from wall-clock guessing. waitState: "spoke" = present and at least one speech recorded; "present" = seated but not yet spoken; "awaiting" = NOT seated, held at the door by lateAdmission:"chair" (the chair can admit it); "absent" = on the roster and not present. `owes` is true when the member is seated and a proposed/seconded motion has no vote from them (`owesWhat` names the motion ids). ★ WHAT WAITING IS NOT: members are NOT resident processes and this framework keeps NO timer for them — a member waiting means "the next turn belongs to somebody else", and after its turn the agent HANDS BACK to the chair. waitRecommended is advice about whether to drive a turn now, not a promise that anything will happen on its own. ★ SINCE RUN 239-D the framework DOES hold a timer and DOES wake: a member with nothing to do can register a `waiters` row (until: speak | vote | motion | poll | phase | attend-all | hand | deadline | meeting-closed, with an optional timeoutMs) and is woken when that event happens — so the sentence above keeps its meaning for `waitStates` (nobody is a resident process and a turn still ends by handing back), while `waiters` is the durable registration that replaces polling and empty turns.
receipt.waitRecommendedWhy: no member is waiting right now: 2 member(s) have already spoken and no floor request is queued
receipt.lateAdmissionMeans: lateAdmission is THIS meeting policy for a late arrival (a late arrival is decided by vmu.meetings.lateAfterMs against openedAt): "open" seats a late member and records late:true; "chair" holds the member at the door (pendingLate) until the chair calls admit(); "refuse" refuses the late arrival by name and names the two repairs (the chair admits, or the member joins the next meeting). THE DEFAULT IS "chair": a late arrival is institutionally a request to be seated, so the chair decides it, and the hold is readable as pendingLate instead of the member slipping in unseen. "open" is the permissive policy and "refuse" the closed one; a meeting row that was opened before this default carries its own recorded value and is not retroactively changed.

arrival.opensOnMeans: the touch that OPENS this meeting is judged on the ELECTORATE (roster minus the seats vmu.meetings.attendDeniedSeats forbids to attend), not on the roster: a member who cannot attend cannot ever "arrive", so waiting for one would be waiting forever
arrival.means: TWO readings of the same room, printed by name: roster presence is "how many of the invited members are in the room", electorate presence is "how many of the members this meeting actually waits for are in the room" — the opening rule uses `opensOn` (electorate), and `missing` names the members still missing from THAT set

receipt.arrivalMeans: TWO readings of the same room, printed by name: roster presence is "how many of the invited members are in the room", electorate presence is "how many of the members this meeting actually waits for are in the room" — the opening rule uses `opensOn` (electorate), and `missing` names the members still missing from THAT set
receipt.requiresChairProceedMeans: false: the meeting is already running — proceed() has nothing left to open; act in it (speak/vote/hand)
receipt.startReadsMeans: startsInMs is non-null ONLY while the meeting has not started (positive = the start time is still in the future, negative = it is overdue); elapsedSinceMs is non-null ONLY once it has started (>= 0, measured from the moment it ACTUALLY opened, i.e. activatedAt — not from scheduledFor); elapsedMs is an alias of elapsedSinceMs kept for old readers (null while not started, never negative). TWO instants are in play and they are NOT the same fact: `openedAt` is the ATTENDANCE BASELINE (the due time, i.e. scheduledFor, fixed when the meeting was scheduled) and `activatedAt` is when the meeting REALLY became runnable (the touch that completed the attendance rule, or the chair proceed). A scheduled meeting that had to wait therefore has openedAt earlier than activatedAt, and `startedLate` says so; `lateReads.openedAt` on an attend receipt is the baseline, and null while the meeting has not started
receipt.waitersMeans: waiters are DURABLE rows on the meeting itself: each names the member and the EVENT it waits for (`until`), the instant it was armed and, when a timeout was given, its deadline. state: "armed" = waiting, the event has not happened yet; "fired" = the event happened and a WAKE WAS ATTEMPTED — `wake.delivered/via/woken` say whether it reached the member, so fired is a DELIVERY fact and NOT a statement that the member has acted, nor that the wake succeeded; "expired" = the deadline passed before the event (only for waits armed with timeoutMs); "cancelled" = withdrawn by unwait(), replaced by a newer wait for the same member, or dropped because the meeting closed. Read `minutes` / `motions` for what actually happened; read `waiters` for who asked to be woken and with what outcome.

waiterStatesMeans.armed: waiting: the event has not happened yet — this member may end its turn; the wake will start it again
waiterStatesMeans.fired: the event happened and a wake was ATTEMPTED for this member; check `wake.delivered` and `wake.via` (a "none" via means no seam and no mailbox existed) — fired does not mean the member acted
waiterStatesMeans.expired: the deadline it named passed before the event; the member was woken under the event name "deadline" so it can re-decide instead of waiting forever
waiterStatesMeans.cancelled: no longer waiting (withdrawn, replaced by a newer wait for the same member, or the meeting closed)

receipt.waitersBecause: `waitStates` (roster / present / held at the door) and `waiters` (event registrations) are TWO facts: waitStates says where a person stands in this meeting NOW, waiters says which EVENT would wake it. Neither is derived from the other

procedure.title: 辩论会议 · 推荐流程骨架
procedure.subject: 辩论对象：命题卡 id（须含已写完的正式证明/证伪或已通过的 Lean 行）、一个文件引用（如 Members/<成员>/Propos/<id>.md 或 Lean 文件）。一句话命题不是对象。lean 已通过但概率仍非 1 的命题，辩论焦点是「代码中的命题与定义是否符合原意」。

steps.what: 各成员各自独立表态：给出该命题当前的布尔概率([0,1])、理由、以及证明/证伪进展。先不互相反驳、不互相引用（「独立」是**尽力而为的约定**，不是内核保证的隔离 —— 见 notes）。

展开辩论：轮流发言 / 举手后发言 / 主席邀请发言。★ 轮数由院士自行决定；本部署只给**动议次数**设了上限 `vmu.meetings.verdictMaxRounds`（默认 3，**任何 kind 的动议都计入**：topic/procedural/resolution 同占额度，程序动议会吃掉一轮辩论）——到限后新增动议会被具名拒 `VMU_RESOURCE_BUDGET`；额度只由这个设置决定——`extend` 延长的是发言、`extendlimit` 延长的是墙钟，两者都不增加动议额度，关会再开一场是另一场会议（额度从头算）。★ `extend`/`silent`/`end`/`hands` 是 primitive 原语，SERVICE 会议上具名拒 `VMU_REGISTRY_BOUNDARY`（primitive 注册表与 SERVICE 会面互不相通），发言界改读 `vibe_v5_say` 回执的 `speechBound`。

会议结束前，每位参加辩论的成员用 `vibe_v5_verdict` 交最终裁决：「布尔概率([0,1])，理由」——传 `meeting` + `proposition_id`（**不要传 `target`**：`target` 只认活票箱的 id，命题卡 id 会被具名拒）、`member` 填自己；主席可以用 `vibe_v5_verdict_ask` 通知还没交的人。★ 别把它和票箱混起来：`vibe_vmu_meeting { action: "ballot" }` 的票箱只对「待核验对象」开放——它的**决定性**票只认 1/0（(0,1) 的读数必须显式写 `estimate` 类型、且不进裁决均值）；票箱不是裁决通道，裁决汇总只读成员交上来的裁决卡（`vibe_v5_verdict_final` 的 `rulingSubmissions`）。
tools: vibe_v5_verdict { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡 id>", verdict: <0..1>, member: "<你>" }
vibe_v5_verdict_ask { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡 id>" }

steps.what: 框架裁定并通知：若全部一致为 1（或一致为 0）则最终概率取该值，否则取所有裁决的平均值；随后通知该命题卡的持有者把卡片概率改为该值。
tools: vibe_v5_verdict_final { meeting: "<本会议>", proposition_id: "<命题卡>", verdicts: [{ member, p, reason }], fidelity?: "conform" | "defect" }

notes: 本骨架是**推荐**：院士可以只做其中一步、改变顺序、或完全不用。框架不检查、不阻断、不记录偏离。

「单次发言版群聊」在本框架里就是「每人各说一次、互不打断」：会议内用 `vibe_vmu_meeting { action:"speak" }`（进会议记录），群聊形态用 `vibe_v5_say`。★ 但「独立」只是**尽力而为的约定**，两条事实要一起看：(a) 框架没有并发，轮次是**顺序**推进的（`kernel/turn` 的 drive 一个成员接一个成员跑），caller 交付模式下更是一格一回合（交回一份提示词、等一份回复，同一时刻只有一个待回回合），提示词装配也**不注入**别人的发言；(b) **即使顺序化、即使不注入前文，读房间仍然可能** —— `vibe_vmu_chat` 走 `chat.list`，内核的聊天读面**不按调用者过滤**，任何成员都能读到整个房间，包括同一轮里别人刚说的话。所以第 1 步的「独立」不是隔离保证：要隔离请用会议发言（进会议记录，工具面没有会议记录的读面）；靠群聊就只能靠这条约定。
发言楼层（谁先说话）是另一套机制：`vibe_vmu_meeting { action:"flow" }`（open/hands/round_robin/call_on）。骨架管议程，flow 管顺序，两者互不替代。
第 4 步不是自动的：`vibe_v5_verdict_final` 由**主席**显式调用（裁决必须有签名人），内核面 `vmu.meetingverdict` 只做算术与校验，通知走既有 mailbox 面 —— 本 pack **没有**在 `meetings.close` 上挂任何自动聚合钩子（"会议关了就把数算出来"会把一次显式裁定变成一次静默推断）。

procedure.note: 这套骨架是**推荐**，不是门禁：院士可以跳过、改序或完全不用，框架不检查也不阻断。

procedureProgress.means: the procedure is a RECOMMENDATION, not a gate: every field here is a COUNT of what is on record — skeletonSteps counts the steps the recommended skeleton LISTS (a property of the recommendation, not progress through it), speeches counts speech entries in the minutes, motions counts motions raised, queued counts the RAW length of the floor queue (entries, not people: it includes members who are not present and entries that never take a turn — read waitingNow for the queue entries who ARE present and can take a turn now, and queuedAbsentList for the names held in the queue without attendance), present counts seated members, and advancing is true when any of those counts is above zero. None of them is a step index: the framework never holds a meeting to a step and would have to invent one to report it

receipt.wallLimitMeans: the meeting’s OWN upper bound, frozen at open: wallLimitMsSource "convene" = the chair set it (durationMs), "vmu.meetings.hardLimitMs" = the deployment default (`1800000` ms here); extendlimit ADDS to the current bound and reports extendedMs, and a request that would pass `vmu.meetings.extendCeilingMs` (`14400000` ms here) is refused WHOLE by name (`VMU_RESOURCE_BUDGET`) — nothing is clamped to the boundary, and there is no unbounded choice
receipt.speechExtendMeans: the SPEECH bound (per member), NOT the meeting's wall bound: `speeches` counts speak() calls recorded on this face and `extensions` counts action="extend" calls that GRANTED time (each one raised that member's speech budget by speechExtendMs, at most speechExtendMax times). When speechExtendMs=0 the declared step is ZERO, so an extend call grants nothing and is answered `applied:false` instead of counting here: `extensions` is a count of grants, not a duration. The meeting's OWN wall clock is wallLimitMs/extendedMs and is raised by action="extendlimit" — two different bounds, two different commands
receipt.turnsMeans: SPEECHES recorded on THIS kernel instance's copy of the meeting (speak() holds its only increment site, `m.turns += 1`); it is NOT a count of member turns — the durable `state.json` `turns` (an array of {member,turn,phase,round,at}) and `vibe_vmu_turn {op:"status"}.turns` are different counters. In a multi-kernel deployment another instance may have delivered a speech it has not written back here, so the durable archived row can hold a larger number than this reading.
receipt.speechesMeans: speeches counts accepted speech acts in this meeting; `turns` is the SAME number under its older name (kept so existing readers do not break) — a member TURN is a different thing, counted by the turn orchestrator
receipt.turnsUnattributedMeans: turns minus Σ speechUsed[].speeches on THIS face. 0 means every counted turn has a recorded speech (the normal case: an accepted speak() raises both). A number > 0 is a turn this instance counts but cannot attribute to a recorded speech — it can only come from a writer that raised `turns` without the matching speech row (another instance, or a turn counted BEFORE the speech was accepted, which the acceptance-point increment above no longer does). It is NOT subtracted from `turns` on a read: the reading says which half is unattributed instead of quietly editing the record
receipt.spokeByMeans: members with at least one recorded speech in THIS meeting (the fact; minutes() is a shaped view of it)
receipt.omittedMeans: empty on purpose: `summary()` and `vibe_vmu_meeting {action:"status"}` both spread THIS block, so neither face drops a member of the who-spoke family (speeches, turnsAccounted, turnsUnattributed and spokeBy appear on both, and speak/close receipts carry the same block). A face that has to drop one must list the key in omittedKeys and say why — a missing key is never its own explanation

motions.text: 仿真：程序动议——把本轮发言上限定为 2 分钟

receipt.votesNote: this counts MOTION votes (and, failing that, minutes vote events); a BALLOT-BOX decision is a different record — read it on the ballot face (boxstatus / the boxclose receipt)
receipt.closureTallyMeans: the closure tally is the INSTITUTE-LEVEL unanimity reading (`vibe_vmu_vote`, read back at `vibe_vmu_status { detail: "closure" }`), and it is a DIFFERENT record from this meeting board: the votes are cast as institute votes, so `present`/`motions`/`votes` above record NO vote events for them. votesCast here next to an empty motion list is two records, not two truths
receipt.closureAccountMeans: no as-of-close account was ever frozen for this meeting: the closure reading is only the LIVE one (closureTally), and a later vote changes it
receipt.rulingsNotOnThisBoard: this board records ATTENDANCE (`present`, which is also the quorum denominator) and SPEECH (`transcript`), and it does NOT record RULINGS: a member files its verdict as a CARD (`vibe_v5_verdict`), and the chair aggregates those cards with `vibe_v5_verdict_final`, whose receipt answers `coverage`, `sources{ n, submitted, typed }` and `attribution`. A member can file a ruling without taking a seat, and can take a seat without filing anything — so "present:1 with an empty transcript" beside "two rulings submitted" is two records (a seat and a card), not two truths, and neither can be computed from the other

receiptMeta.note: NOTHING was elided by us: this receipt is over MAX_TOOL_RESULT_BYTES (12000) but no string leaf exceeded 2000, and meeting the budget would require dropping content, which would change its shape. `originalBytes` is the real size. The HOST may insert its own `[...]` marker (hostElision) - that one is outside this receipt.

receipt.means: these are the ruling CARDS filed for this (meeting, proposition) by the members themselves (vibe_v5_verdict { meeting, proposition_id, verdict, reason, member }): `rows` is the latest filing per member, `cards` counts the cards filed for THIS (meeting, proposition), `cardsScanned` counts every ruling-status card the library holds (so `cards:0` beside `cardsScanned:2` is not a contradiction — it means the cards on disk are about other debates), and `duplicates` reports a member who filed two different values (the latest is the one the tally uses). Reading does NOT tally and does NOT decide — the chair still signs with vibe_v5_verdict_final. `readable:false` means no filing could be read (see `why`), which is NOT the same as "nobody filed". ★ THE TOP-LEVEL `count` OF THIS FACE IS the number `vibe_v5_verdict_final` reports as `submissions.count` for the same (meeting, proposition) — the same fact in two shapes, so the absence of a `submissions` block here is not a missing number

types.label: 正常会议
types.purpose: 例行同步：本所/小组的进展、分工、阻塞与下一步。
types.narrowingReason: 正常会议不按类型收窄工具面：例行同步需要什么就用什么（没有"正常会议专用工具"这回事）。

types.label: 学术交流
types.purpose: 围绕研究方向互相报告与提问，把要追的线索落到记录上。

steps.what: 各方向报告当前状态：已有结论、正在试的路、卡住的点。能落卡的结论要落卡（记录面才是机构记忆）。
交叉提问与追问：举手/邀请发言后由本人回答。重点是"这一步为什么成立"，不是"做没做"。
把要追的线索与待验证的猜想落成任务/子问题卡，散会后再也不会"没人记得"。

types.narrowingReason: 学术交流不按类型收窄工具面：报告与提问都可能临时需要记录、检索、任务面。

types.label: 辩论
types.purpose: 围绕一个命题（含已写完证明的命题卡 / 文件引用）辩论，以最终裁决给出布尔概率。

types.narrowingReason: 辩论会议期间收窄到"发言/记录/查库/投票/裁决/会议"这几类：辩论是议题内的对抗，不是修改机构状态的场合。

types.label: 结题
types.purpose: 确认目标是否达成、缺什么，并对"是否达标"表决与归档。

steps.what: 清点已完成的东西：目标逐条对照，只有能指到产物/记录的才算完成。
点名缺口：缺什么、为什么缺、补它需要什么。不许用"基本完成"略过。

对「是否达标」表决。★ 结题票走 `vibe_vmu_vote { member, solved }`（机构级、写进 `closure_votes`，`close` 回执与 `vibe_vmu_status { detail: "closure" }` 读的就是它）；`vibe_v5_poll_*` 是另一套票板，**不计入** `closureVote`。人数下限**已实现**：`kernel/meetings.js` 的 `quorumOf` 计算 m = min(所设上限, 在册有表决权人数)，`vibe_v5_verdict_final` 的 floor 读同一个函数并在裁决这一步执行（不足 m 具名拒 `VMU_MEETING_QUORUM_LOST`，例外须 `partial: true` + `why`）；会议关闭本身不读票数（关会的 rails 只有主席、上次纪要确认与待办清单）。
tools: vibe_v5_meeting { action: "close", id: "<会 id>", actor: "<主席席>" }

steps.what: 把结题结论归档：结论、依据、遗留项各一段，交给机构记录而不是留在会议记录里。

types.narrowingReason: 结题会议不按类型收窄工具面：清点产物、点名缺口都可能需要读全库与任务面。

types.label: 论文交流
types.purpose: 围绕一篇论文稿的提交、互审、修订与定稿。

steps.what: 稿件的当前版本先落到论文子系统（start/sections/status 都可读回），再在会上公示版本与变化。
交叉互审：每位评审给出"可交付 / 需修改"的判定与理由；判定要落进论文子系统的 review 面。
tools: vibe_v5_paper { action: "review", target: "<论文 id>", deliverable: true|false, notes: "<理由>" }

steps.what: 按评审意见修订后推进状态；定稿要过所办咨询闸（`vmu.paper.officeConsult`），所办用 `consult` 答复后才放行。
tools: vibe_v5_paper { action: "consult", target: "<论文 id>", member: "<所办>", answer: "<意见>" }
vibe_v5_paper { action: "final", target: "<论文 id>", member: "<院士>", deliverable: true }

types.narrowingReason: 论文交流不按类型收窄工具面：互审与修订本来就要在论文子系统里动。

types.label: 未来规划/策划
types.purpose: 基于现状与约束，给出备选路线与阶段计划。

steps.what: 先把现状与约束摊开：目标、已完成、已知阻塞、外部限制。没有现状的规划是许愿。
列备选路线（至少两条），每条写清代价、风险、可验证的里程碑；方法/路线落卡，别只存在于发言里。
把选定路线拆成阶段任务，标出优先级与依赖；先做哪一步、什么条件下改路线要写下来。
确认阶段计划：要形成机构决定就表决，并把结果记录（谁赞成、谁保留、什么条件下重议）。

types.narrowingReason: 规划会议不按类型收窄工具面：备选路线要读库、要落方法卡，收窄反而逼人凭记忆规划。

receipt.means: 六型就是从这两张声明里读出来的，这里没有第二份手维表。convene 时 type 对着同一份目录校验，工具面收窄也在同一轮打开（applyMeetingTypeFace）；`procedureSteps` 是该型被绑定的必走步数，空就是「不绑步骤」而不是「没有程序」（看 `hasProcedure`）。

receipt.turnsMeans: SPEECHES recorded on THIS kernel instance's copy of the meeting (speak() holds its only increment site, `m.turns += 1`); it is NOT a count of member turns — the durable `state.json` `turns` (an array of {member,turn,phase,round,at}) and `vibe_vmu_turn {op:"status"}.turns` are different counters. In a multi-kernel deployment another instance may have delivered a speech it has not written back here, so the durable archived row can hold a larger number than this reading.
receipt.speechesMeans: speeches counts accepted speech acts in this meeting; `turns` is the SAME number under its older name (kept so existing readers do not break) — a member TURN is a different thing, counted by the turn orchestrator
receipt.turnsUnattributedMeans: turns minus Σ speechUsed[].speeches on THIS face. 0 means every counted turn has a recorded speech (the normal case: an accepted speak() raises both). A number > 0 is a turn this instance counts but cannot attribute to a recorded speech — it can only come from a writer that raised `turns` without the matching speech row (another instance, or a turn counted BEFORE the speech was accepted, which the acceptance-point increment above no longer does). It is NOT subtracted from `turns` on a read: the reading says which half is unattributed instead of quietly editing the record
receipt.spokeByMeans: members with at least one recorded speech in THIS meeting (the fact; minutes() is a shaped view of it)
receipt.omittedMeans: empty on purpose: `summary()` and `vibe_vmu_meeting {action:"status"}` both spread THIS block, so neither face drops a member of the who-spoke family (speeches, turnsAccounted, turnsUnattributed and spokeBy appear on both, and speak/close receipts carry the same block). A face that has to drop one must list the key in omittedKeys and say why — a missing key is never its own explanation

receipt.firedWaitersMeans: every waiter THIS call fired, with the delivery of its wake: `{ member, until, id, wake }`. Fired is a DELIVERY fact, not a promise that the member acted: vmu.meetings.wakeFailurePolicy decides what a failed wake means and the event is NEVER rolled back because a wake failed. The array is empty when no waiter was waiting for this event (the means line stays, so an empty array is not silent).

receipt.note: closed in the meetings SERVICE: the meeting moved to the service ARCHIVE (not the primitive live table); its MOTIONS and the minutes vote events remain readable via action=summary (a BALLOT-BOX decision is a different record: read the box face for its tally)
receipt.stateMeans: the meeting AFTER this close, as its own record reads it (the value is read from the archived row, not assumed): a closed meeting has a frozen tally and hidden vote detail
receipt.archivedMeans: the record left the service live table and is held by the service ARCHIVE; `summary`/`status` read it back by id

subjectGate.note: 文件形态：调用方自报可读且非空（bytes=1024），本闸**没有**文件系统接缝、未自行 stat；"内容是否写完"由辩论中的人核 ⇒ 回执如实标 proofContentChecked:false、evidenceSource:"caller-reported"

receipt.subjectGateMeans: the debate-subject verdict stored with the meeting when it was CONVENED — the close receipt repeats it so a closer does not have to make a second call; reading cannot change it

closureVote.windowMeans: the map is this orchestrator's, but every vote is also written to the durable fold key "closure_votes", so it spans the INSTITUTE. `missing` means "no recorded judgement" this reading can see; a member who voted in ANOTHER session IS visible here through that fold
closureVote.rulingReading: NOT here: cast/votesCast are the CLOSURE vote; the DEBATE ruling is `vibe_v5_verdict_final`
closureVote.castMeaning: cast === confirmed: every enfranchised member judged it solved; NOT "votes were cast" — see votesCast for arrivals
closureVote.notEligibleMeans: members who judged but hold no closure-vote permission: recorded, neither counted nor listed as missing
closureVote.votersMeans: who voted, one row per member, the LATEST judgement wins
closureVote.reason: silence blocks the CLOSURE VOTE (unanimity on「每个有投票权的成员都判定该问题已解决」) — it does NOT block closing the meeting (close rails: vmu.meetings.*; never decides close legality). Waiting: r-acad, r-1, r-2

receipt.readForMeetingMeans: `closureVote.meetingId` is null BY DESIGN: the tally is INSTITUTE-WIDE (one durable key, latest-wins), not a per-meeting ballot, so it carries no meeting id of its own. readForMeeting names the meeting whose CLOSE this reading was taken for — the same tally is read at every close of the institute
receipt.closureVoteAsOfMeans: the instant the closureVote numbers above were computed; this close does NOT freeze the reading — a vote cast after it changes the same durable record, so quote closureVote + closureVoteAsOf together as the as-of-close account
receipt.countedMeans: counted answers ONE question: did the CLOSURE reading hold any vote at the instant of this close. It is NOT a condition of the close (the close passed the rails in `enforced`): counted=false means nobody had voted on "is this solved" yet, so quote closureVote.missing for who to ask — a close is not a unanimous judgement

closureVoteFrozen.means: this row is the as-of-close closure reading: 0 vote(s) cast, cast=false, confirmed=false, missing=["r-acad","r-1","r-2"]. It is a RECORD, not a live view: later votes change `vibe_vmu_status { detail: "closure" }` and never this row, so quote it when the question is "what did the institute decide at close"
closureVoteFrozen.readingMeans: a later reader can compare: `vibe_vmu_status { detail: "closure" }` = the current latest-wins reading; this row = the reading at the instant of the close. Two different questions, two different answers, both honest
closureVoteFrozen.gatingMeans: freezing is bookkeeping: it does not decide the close and the close does not decide the vote

receipt.closureVoteFrozenMeans: the as-of-close closure reading is now a durable record (rec-10) on the `state` track; later votes change the live reading and never this row
receipt.closureVoteNote: closureVote (cast/confirmed/votesCast/missing) is the SEPARATE unanimity reading over the same INSTANCE, not a requirement of this close and not changed by it: this close passed the rails named in `enforced` (vmu.meetings.closeRequiresChair, vmu.meetings.confirmPreviousMinutes, vmu.meetings.committeeReportRequired, vmu.meetings.minutesActionsRequired) while the closure vote reads cast=false, confirmed=false, missing=["r-acad","r-1","r-2"] — so "closed" does not mean "unanimously judged solved", and a member named in `missing` is who to ask before claiming closure. THE VOTES ARE CAST THROUGH `vibe_vmu_vote` AT THE INSTITUTE LEVEL, so the meeting board (`present`, `motions`, `votes`) records NO vote events for them: a chair who sees votesCast=0 next to an empty motions list is reading two different records, not two different truths. ★ Closing does NOT freeze this reading: it is the durable, latest-wins record (closureVoteAsOf names the instant it was read), so a vote cast after this close changes what a later reader sees while the numbers in THIS receipt stay the as-of-close account
receipt.callerIsSeatMeans: this key answers ONE question: did this call run from the named seat and its own session? It does not say whether the seat carried the act out - that is what a delivered turn (turnReceipts, deliveryPath) answers
receipt.ranInOwnTurnMeans: true when this call ran from the seat own session, or when the kernel reported that a turn for this seat was actually DELIVERED and returned (out.turnDelivered) - the two facts that one key used to conflate
receipt.memberActedMeans: this call ran from the OFFICE (a root session, which is not a seat) and named member "r-acad": the record was written IN THAT SEAT'S NAME, but the seat did not act in its own turn. `memberActed:false` states that difference - orchestrating on a seat's behalf is not the same act as carrying it out, and a reader who needs the seat's own judgement should ask for it in a turn of that seat
receipt.firedWaitersMeans: every waiter THIS call fired, with the delivery of its wake: `{ member, until, id, wake }`. Fired is a DELIVERY fact, not a promise that the member acted: vmu.meetings.wakeFailurePolicy decides what a failed wake means and the event is NEVER rolled back because a wake failed. The array is empty when no waiter was waiting for this event (the means line stays, so an empty array is not silent).

receiptMeta.note: NOTHING was elided by us: this receipt is over MAX_TOOL_RESULT_BYTES (12000) but no string leaf exceeded 2000, and meeting the budget would require dropping content, which would change its shape. `originalBytes` is the real size. The HOST may insert its own `[...]` marker (hostElision) - that one is outside this receipt.

droppedNote.subject: the PRIMITIVE meeting record has NO subject field (kernel/meeting.js keeps id/kind/state/agenda/roster, and `subject` is read back only from the SERVICE record). It was NOT stored: pass it to the service face instead — vibe_v5_meeting {action:"open", subject:"…"} (or the pack convene face, which requires it for a debate). This open still created the primitive meeting, so the pointer is disclosed as dropped rather than failing the call

watchdogs.means: no watchdog port was injected: the count of stale meet/verify clocks cannot be taken at all (targets:null, never 0 — a zero nobody measured is manufactured), so a stale clock would go unrefreshed here
